notes.author: human:product-owner
notes.text: Milestone split: M1 is the secure platform foundation only. User-facing .env replacement moves to M2.

problem: Runtime secret delivery, synchronization and AI access need a stable security and domain foundation.
scope: Next.js + TypeScript control plane with PostgreSQL and Drizzle; no SQLite.
Better Auth with self-hostable local authentication and future optional OIDC.
Application-owned authorization independent from identity provider.
Core model: User, Device, Project, Environment, Secret, SecretVersion, AccessGrant, AuditEvent.
Encryption/key-envelope foundation and OS-native device key storage.
Rust sec client bootstrap, browser/device authorization and revocable device identity.
Append-only audit path without secret plaintext.
Keep login/device authorization separate from cryptographic unlock.
title: Milestone 1: secure core foundation
validation: Self-hosted app + PostgreSQL can authenticate a local user without mandatory hosted identity.
User can create project, environment and encrypted SecretVersion.
Rust client can register a device and revoked device cannot obtain new grants.
Audit identifies actor/device/action/target without secret values.
value: Provide a stable foundation for runtime, sync, lifecycle and AI capabilities.
